//: Fallback pm2 process definition, used by deploy.sh only when pm2 has no
process registered under PM2_NAME and there is no ecosystem.config.js on
the server. The live box already has ecosystem.config.js, which wins.
Paths are absolute because pm2 resolves 'interpreter' against its own cwd,
not the app's. Change them here and set APP_DIR to match if you move the app.
'interpreter' points at the virtualenv python — without it pm2 assumes node
and the process dies instantly with a syntax error.
